parsed_json.up: Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in human assays against the target Histone-lysine N-methyltransferase 2A. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays, then to target_dictionary. Filter by target pref_name and assay organism. Require structures via INNER JOIN compound_structures. Sort by compound ChEMBL identifier.
